tx.identity: E79-A on CH340 COM12 (USB location 1-8.3), measured by PPK2 E753C4E81F3D; mapping verified by RX ON/OFF current steps

rx.identity: E79-B on CH340 COM13 (USB location 1-8.1.2), measured by PPK2 CD2D332DB09A; mapping verified by RX ON/OFF current steps

supply_provenance: Operator explicitly confirmed external 3.3 V at PPK2 VIN and supply exclusively through PPK2 on 2026-09-30.

method.delta_uJ: energy_uJ - V * pretrigger_mean_uA * window_seconds; signed, no clipping
method.dispersion: Sample SD across the five transfers; not absolute measurement uncertainty
method.primary_window_reason: Fixed 0..200 ms per local marker; host callback coverage is checked, but independent sample clocks do not define synchronized RF boundaries
method.scope: Observation budgets include listening, idle, UART and firmware activity; baseline subtraction is not RF-only energy
method.voltage: Constant operator-confirmed supply; voltage was not sampled with current
method.loss: Recorded sample-loss value is a duration/count estimate, not proof of stream continuity
method.wire_counter_caveat: Modulo-64 continuity cannot detect losses of multiples of 64; counter anomalies do not identify ADC corruption or a definite number of missing samples. No samples repaired or removed.
method.legacy_rx: 0..4.76 ms at host marker is listening; it precedes the observed receive-associated activity
method.legacy_tx: Aligned 4.76 ms model = (32+12)*8/200000 s + 0.003 s; not measured RF airtime
method.rf_only_rx_status: Not identifiable from software-marker/current data without a validated RF-active interval
